issues.display_title: Issue #1204: Editor Map tab: the "No floors yet" card covers the bottom toolbar's menus
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Found while checking #1201 (2026-10-08). On a project with no floors, the editor's Map tab shows the "No floors yet" card in the middle of the canvas. On a window about 900 px tall, the bottom toolbar's dropdown menus open behind that card, and their upper rows cannot be clicked. For example, Street Map Filter in the Map layer menu is covered and unreachable.

Cause

  • EmptyProjectPlaceholder (src/components/editor/EmptyProjectPlaceholder.tsx) is an absolute inset-0 z-20 layer.
  • The Map tab's bottom toolbar (EditorBottomToolbar) is also z-20, and both are children of #editor-canvas-surface (EditorCanvas).
  • The placeholder comes later in the DOM, so it paints above the toolbar. A toolbar menu's own z-30 (ToolMenu) only counts inside the toolbar's stacking context.
  • Its card is pointer-events-auto, so it takes the clicks too.

This is on development as of abbd8130, and on production.

Scope

  1. The Map tab's floating chrome (bottom toolbar and its menus, tilt/zoom controls, selected feature panel) sits above the "No floors yet" card, so every menu row is visible and clickable.
  2. The card itself stays where it is, still above the map, and its Add Floor button and file drop keep working.
  3. The Editor tab, where the card shows alone, looks the same.

Acceptance criteria

  • On a project with no floors, in a 1440×900 window, every row of the Map layer menu is visible and clickable on the Map tab.
  • The "No floors yet" card is still shown above the map, and Add Floor still opens the Add Floor flow.
  • The Editor tab's empty state is unchanged.

RESULT

video-1204-no-floors-menu.mp4

Released to main in d4cffcf2 (release PR #1206). The fix came in through PR #1205, merged to development as 7ba9774a; the fix commit is f3833b58. Deploy succeeded.

On a project with no floors, the "No floors yet" card now sits under the editor Map tab's toolbar and controls. Every row of the toolbar's dropdown menus is visible and clickable at 1440×900. The card is still above the map, its Add Floor still opens the Add Floor modal, and the Editor tab's empty state is unchanged.

Fix

  • src/components/editor/EmptyProjectPlaceholder.tsx: the layer is z-10 instead of z-20.
  • Before, as an equal z-20 sibling of the Map tab's bottom toolbar that came later in the DOM, it painted over the toolbar's menus and its card took their clicks.

Tests

  • New src/components/editor/__tests__/EmptyProjectPlaceholder.stacking.test.tsx: the layer stays below the toolbar. Putting it back to z-20 fails it.
  • pnpm test (2972), pnpm lint, tsc --noEmit and next build pass.

Checked

  • Real Chrome at 1440×900 (.playwright-mcp/demo/1204/check-no-floors-menu.mjs, elementFromPoint on each menu row), development against the fix: 7/7.
  • Production map-thru.com after the deploy: 5/5.
    • All three Map layer rows are on top, and Street takes a real click.
    • The card is still on top of the map.
    • Add Floor opens its modal.
    • The Editor tab card is unchanged.
  • Empty scratch projects only; every one was deleted.
  • Demo: .playwright-mcp/demo/1204/video-1204-no-floors-menu.mp4.
